title: TessNova Generic Incident Event Contract (Proposed)
description: Standardized event schema forwarded to the team decision engine for correlation and response dispatch.

incident_id.description: Unique UUID or structured identifier for the incident.

observed_at.description: Unix timestamp when incident was formulated.

severity.description: Calculated or assigned incident severity level.

source.description: Originating detector or agent component (e.g. M4, M5, MosquittoACL).

reasons.description: Machine-readable anomaly indicators or trigger conditions.

evidence_refs.description: URI or file references to captured evidence (avoiding embedding raw packet/payload bloat).

recommended_action.description: Advisory action recommendation for the central decision agent.
